reason: I don't do crypto. I'm not setting up a Solana wallet or holding USDC to pay for a 50 dollar task, and I'd have to explain that to whoever signs off on my spend.

would_change_my_mind: Let me pay by card or invoice in dollars, with no wallet and no USDC on my side, plus a receipt I can hand to finance.
